Comparative ranked GSEA waterfall, volcano, scatter-style plots Comparative ranked GSEA waterfall, volcano, scatter-style plots Standalone R functions for ranked GSEA GO terms, directional volcano plots, and cross-contrast NES comparisons. Author: Zoheb Khan Example: GSE122380 GO biological-process GSEA contrasts Source: ZohebKhan1/gsea-waterfall 1 Overview gsea-waterfall is a copyable R plotting toolkit for precomputed Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) results. It provides ranked positive and negative NES waterfall plots, a symmetric volcano plot, directional half-volcano plots, and comparative NES scatterplots. The functions do not run GSEA or modify supplied enrichment statistics. They select and display rows according to explicit plotting arguments. The worked example uses GO biological-process results from GSE122380 cardiomyocyte differentiation contrasts. Rendered tutorial: https://zohebkhan1.github.io/gsea-waterfall/ The waterfall layout is inspired by pathway-level figures in Ciceri, Nature, 2024, Xu, Nature Cell Biology, 2025, Vuong, Science, 2026, and Risgaard, Science, 2026. 2 Install And Source The Functions Install the plotting dependencies once: utils::install.packages(c('ggplot2', 'ggrepel', 'RColorBrewer', 'scales')) Download the shared utilities first, then the plot modules you need: base_url <- 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZohebKhan1/gsea-waterfall/main/functions' utils::download.file(paste0(base_url, '/gsea_plot_utils.R'), 'gsea_plot_utils.R') utils::download.file(paste0(base_url, '/gsea_waterfall_plot.R'), 'gsea_waterfall_plot.R') utils::download.file(paste0(base_url, '/gsea_volcano_plot.R'), 'gsea_volcano_plot.R') utils::download.file(paste0(base_url, '/gsea_half_volcano_plot.R'), 'gsea_half_volcano_plot.R') utils::download.file(paste0(base_url, '/gsea_nes_scatter_plot.R'), 'gsea_nes_scatter_plot.R') source('gsea_plot_utils.R') source('gsea_waterfall_plot.R') source('gsea_volcano_plot.R') source('gsea_half_volcano_plot.R') source('gsea_nes_scatter_plot.R') 3 Input Contract Each table represents one GSEA contrast with one row per unique term. The default columns are: Column Required Meaning go_description yes unique GO term name and default matching key NES yes normalized enrichment score pval yes nominal GSEA p-value in [0, 1] padj yes adjusted p-value in [0, 1] All four columns must be complete, and NES values must be finite. If descriptions are not unique, supply a complete unique identifier column through id_col. Comparative scatterplots use the exact shared identifier intersection; they do not impute absent terms. Load the bundled examples from the repository root: gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm <- read_gsea_result_csv( 'tutorial/data/GSE122380_gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm.csv' ) gsea_day9_vs_day6 <- read_gsea_result_csv( 'tutorial/data/GSE122380_gsea_day9_vs_day6.csv' ) gsea_day3_vs_day1 <- read_gsea_result_csv( 'tutorial/data/GSE122380_gsea_day3_vs_day1.csv' ) 4 Waterfall Plots plot_gsea_waterfall() selects one NES direction, ranks terms by NES, padj, or pvalue, and displays the first top_n rows. term_groups controls point colors; label_terms independently controls direct labels. Text seeds are matched case-insensitively against term descriptions, while supplied term IDs are matched exactly after case normalization. 4.1 Positive NES waterfall positive_term_groups <- list( 'Ion channel' = c( 'Calcium', 'Sodium', 'Potassium', 'Ion', 'Voltage', 'Channel', 'electrical', 'Action potential', 'transmembrane', 'conduction' ), 'Metabolism' = c( 'Metabolic', 'Metabolism', 'Electron transport chain', 'Mitochondria', 'Mitochondrial', 'Oxidative', 'Phosphorylation', 'ATP', 'lipid', 'biosynthetic', 'respiration' ), 'Muscle contraction' = c( 'Muscle contraction', 'Muscle cell differentiation', 'Striated', 'Sarcomere', 'Myofibril', 'Actin', 'Muscle' ), 'Heart development' = c('atrial', 'ventricular', 'heart', 'cardiac') ) positive_label_terms <- c( 'myofibril assembly', 'cardiac muscle contraction', 'cardiac muscle cell action potential', 'calcium-mediated signaling', 'electron transport chain', 'muscle cell differentiation', 'ATP metabolic process', 'cardiac cell development', 'cardiac chamber morphogenesis', 'muscle contraction', 'cardiac conduction', 'cardiac muscle cell contraction', 'heart growth', 'cardiac atrium development', 'heart trabecula morphogenesis' ) positive_waterfall <- plot_gsea_waterfall( gsea_results = gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm, direction = 'positive', top_n = 100L, rank_by = 'NES', x_label = 'Ranked GO terms by NES for Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm', label_terms = positive_label_terms, term_groups = positive_term_groups ) Figure 1. Positive NES GO biological-process waterfall for Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm. Terms are ranked by NES, colored by manually defined cardiac-relevant groups, and labeled with selected terms. 4.2 Negative NES waterfall negative_term_groups <- list( 'Ribosomal' = c('ribosome', 'ribosomal', 'spliceosomal', 'rRNA', 'RNA'), 'Mitosis' = c( 'Mitosis', 'Meiosis', 'Nuclear division', 'cell cycle', 'telomere', 'spindle', 'Mitotic', 'Meiotic' ), 'DNA replication' = c('chromosome', 'DNA', 'base', 'repair', 'DNA-') ) negative_term_group_colors <- c( 'Ribosomal' = '#377EB8', 'Mitosis' = '#984EA3', 'DNA replication' = '#E41A1C' ) negative_waterfall <- plot_gsea_waterfall( gsea_results = gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm, direction = 'negative', top_n = 100L, rank_by = 'NES', x_label = 'Ranked GO terms by NES for Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm', label_n = 10L, term_groups = negative_term_groups, term_group_colors = negative_term_group_colors ) Figure 2. Negative NES GO biological-process waterfall for the same contrast. The selected groups highlight ribosomal, mitotic, and DNA-replication programs. 5 Volcano Plots Use plot_gsea_volcano() for both NES directions in one panel and plot_gsea_half_volcano() for a larger directional view. The example retains the established adjusted p-value cutoff of 0.05. 5.1 Symmetric volcano volcano_label_terms <- c( 'cardiac muscle contraction', 'muscle cell differentiation', 'cardiac chamber morphogenesis', 'heart growth', 'heart valve development', 'mitotic nuclear division', 'DNA replication initiation', 'mitotic G2/M transition checkpoint', 'centriole assembly', 'ribosome assembly' ) symmetric_volcano <- plot_gsea_volcano( gsea_results = gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm, padj_cutoff = 0.05, label_terms = volcano_label_terms, contrast_label = 'Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm', label_words_per_line = 3L ) Figure 3. Symmetric GO biological-process GSEA volcano for Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm. Point color marks significant positive, significant negative, or non-significant enrichment. 5.2 Directional half-volcano plots positive_half_volcano_label_terms <- c( 'myofibril assembly', 'cardiac muscle contraction', 'cardiac muscle cell action potential', 'electron transport chain', 'muscle cell differentiation', 'cardiac cell development', 'cardiac chamber morphogenesis', 'muscle contraction', 'cardiac conduction', 'heart growth', 'heart trabecula morphogenesis' ) positive_half_volcano <- plot_gsea_half_volcano( gsea_results = gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm, direction = 'positive', p_col = 'padj', padj_cutoff = 0.05, label_terms = positive_half_volcano_label_terms, term_groups = positive_term_groups, inner_nes_limit = 1, contrast_label = 'Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm' ) Figure 4. Positive NES half-volcano for Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm. The enlarged view uses the same biological grouping logic as the waterfall plot. negative_half_volcano_label_terms <- c( 'DNA-templated DNA replication', 'DNA replication', 'cell cycle checkpoint signaling', 'mitotic cell cycle checkpoint signaling', 'ribosome biogenesis', 'recombinational repair', 'DNA replication initiation', 'cell cycle DNA replication', 'spindle organization' ) negative_half_volcano <- plot_gsea_half_volcano( gsea_results = gsea_cardiomyocyte_vs_mesoderm, direction = 'negative', p_col = 'padj', padj_cutoff = 0.05, label_terms = negative_half_volcano_label_terms, term_groups = negative_term_groups, term_group_colors = negative_term_group_colors, inner_nes_limit = 1, contrast_label = 'Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm' ) Figure 5. Negative NES half-volcano for Cardiomyocyte vs. Mesoderm. Selected labels emphasize DNA replication, checkpoint, and ribosome-associated programs. 6 Comparative NES Scatterplot plot_gsea_nes_scatter() compares the exact shared term-key intersection. The fitted line is descriptive; the helper does not calculate a new enrichment statistic. scatter_label_terms <- c( 'mesenchyme development', 'mesoderm development', 'mesodermal cell differentiation', 'myofibril assembly', 'heart process', 'oxidative phosphorylation', 'regulation of nuclear division' ) all_quadrants_scatter <- plot_gsea_nes_scatter( gsea_x = gsea_day9_vs_day6, gsea_y = gsea_day3_vs_day1, x_label = 'Day 9 vs. Day 6 NES', y_label = 'Day 3 vs. Day 1 NES', color_by = 'significance', quadrant = 'all', x_name = 'Day 9 vs. Day 6', y_name = 'Day 3 vs. Day 1', label_terms = scatter_label_terms, padj_cutoff = 0.05, include_nonsignificant = TRUE, equal_axis_limits = TRUE, show_fit_line = TRUE ) Figure 6. Comparative GO biological-process NES scatterplot for Day 9 vs. Day 6 and Day 3 vs. Day 1. Point color shows significance in one, both, or neither contrast. 7 Function Reference Function Contract read_gsea_result_csv() reads and validates one precomputed CSV without filtering rows plot_gsea_waterfall() returns a ranked one-direction ggplot plot_gsea_volcano() returns a symmetric NES-versus-adjusted-p-value ggplot plot_gsea_half_volcano() returns a directional ggplot after the explicit NES boundary plot_gsea_nes_scatter() returns a ggplot from the exact shared term-key intersection All plot functions return ggplot objects and do not write files. Their source-level documentation defines the complete argument and return contracts. The common input-column arguments are term_col, nes_col, pvalue_col, padj_col, and optional id_col; visual arguments control labels, colors, dimensions inside the panel, and legends without changing the supplied enrichment values. 8 Reproduce The Repository Install the rendering dependencies and run the maintained scripts from the repository root: utils::install.packages(c( 'base64enc', 'bookdown', 'knitr', 'rmarkdown', 'svglite', 'systemfonts' )) Rscript R/01_generate_gsea_figs.R Rscript R/02_render_github_pgs.R Rscript R/03_check_gsea_contracts.R The first script writes the six editable, font-embedded SVGs under tutorial/assets/figures/. The second renders tutorial/tutorial.Rmd into docs/ for GitHub Pages. The third verifies the fixed scientific counts, plot contracts, public API, identifier matching, and invalid-input boundaries.
